_comment: A4 · Auto-Pain-Score · computes Pain Score and OPCO Multiplier when scoring fields are populated. The formula differs by VS area: ITBA includes Safety, CS does not (CS has no field crew per Avangrid TOM v3). Trigger fires whenever any of the score fields changes — guarded by the readiness condition.
name: A4 · Auto-Pain-Score
description: Compute DP Pain Score + DP OPCO Multiplier from BV / UX / [Safety] / Effort. Formula: ITBA → (BV·OPCOmult·0.45 + UX·0.30 + Safety·0.25)/Effort · CS → (BV·OPCOmult·0.40 + UX·0.60)/Effort.

conditions._human_readable: If VS area = CS, Safety not required

actions._step: Compute DP OPCO Multiplier from OpCo (multi-select count)
Compute DP Pain Score · branch by VS area
actions._branch_condition: If DP Value Stream Destination is in the CS list → use expression_cs, else → expression_itba

actions.comment: Auto-Pain-Score recalculated by A4. New Pain Score = {{issue."DP Pain Score"}} (OPCO mult = {{issue."DP OPCO Multiplier"}}).

_steps_human_readable: 1. Trigger: any of {Business Value, DP UX Score, Safety, Effort, OpCo} changes.
2. Condition: BV, UX, Effort all populated. Safety required only if VS in ITBA area.
3. Action: compute DP OPCO Multiplier (1.0 / 1.3 / 1.6 by OpCo count).
4. Action: compute DP Pain Score using ITBA or CS formula based on VS area.
5. Action: add comment with audit trail.
Note: Pain Score field must be writeable by automation but read-only to humans (enforce via field config + permission scheme).
